assignedReviews.competency_evidence: observe the root and shoot system in plants and describe why they are important
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about voltage and has no content on the root and shoot system of plants or their importance.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe how plant organs (leaf, stem, roots) work together as the transport system
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses voltage, not how plant organs (leaf, stem, roots) work together as a transport system.

copy.en: Voltage is the work needed per unit charge to move charges between two points, and it is measured in volts (V).
copy.tl: Ang voltage ay ang trabahong kailangan para sa bawat unit ng charge upang mapakilos ang mga charge sa pagitan ng dalawang punto, at sinusukat ito sa volts (V).
copy.bis: Ang voltage mao ang trabaho nga gikinahanglan kada unit sa charge aron mapalihok ang mga charge tali sa duha ka punto, ug gisukod kini sa volts (V).

assignedReviews.reason: The card describes a voltaic cell and redox reaction, which is electrochemistry, not weather disturbances in or near the Philippines. No support for the competency.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe how changes in the weather can affect daily activities and explain how some types of weather can be dangerous for people
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about voltaic cells and chemical change, not about weather changes affecting daily activities or dangerous weather. Unrelated to the competency.

copy.en: A voltaic cell produces electric current from a spontaneous redox reaction, a chemical change where electrons move from one metal to another.
copy.tl: Ang voltaic cell ay gumagawa ng electric current mula sa spontaneous redox reaction, isang pagbabagong kemikal kung saan lumilipat ang mga electron mula sa isang metal papunta sa isa pa.
copy.bis: Ang voltaic cell mopagawas ug electric current gikan sa spontaneous redox reaction, usa ka kemikal nga pagbag-o diin ang mga electron molalin gikan sa usa ka metal ngadto sa lain.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: her speed is 0.5 meter per second

assignedReviews.reason: The card is about calculating walking speed, a physics/motion topic. It provides no information about the digestive tract, digestive processes, or any labeled diagram, so it does not support G8-L-1.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify from pictures and labeled diagrams the parts of the digestive system as mouth, gullet, stomach, small intestine, and large intestine, and describe how they work

copy.en: If a Grade 4 pupil walks 10 meters from the canteen to her classroom in 20 seconds, her speed is 0.5 meter per second.
copy.tl: Kung ang isang mag-aaral sa Grade 4 ay naglakad ng 10 metro mula canteen papunta sa kanyang silid-aralan sa loob ng 20 segundo, ang speed niya ay 0.5 meter per second.
copy.bis: Kung ang usa ka estudyante sa Grade 4 milakaw ug 10 metros gikan sa canteen padulong sa iyang classroom sa 20 ka segundo, ang iyang speed kay 0.5 meter per second.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Endothermic, or warm-blooded, vertebrates keep a constant body temperature
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: demonstrate through guided investigation the advantages and limitations of simple machines, such as inclined planes, wedges, levers, and pulleys
assignedReviews.reason: Card describes endothermic vertebrates and constant body temperature; it has no relation to simple machines, their advantages/limitations, or guided investigations of them.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Endothermic, or warm-blooded, vertebrates keep a constant body temperature
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: observe and describe examples and uses of simple machines found at home, at school, and in the community
assignedReviews.reason: Card is about warm-blooded animals, not about observing or describing simple machines at home, school, or community.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: carry out fair tests to show how levers can be used to change the magnitude and direction of a force
assignedReviews.reason: Card has no content about levers, fair tests, or changing force magnitude/direction; it is entirely about animal thermoregulation.

copy.en: Endothermic, or warm-blooded, vertebrates keep a constant body temperature no matter how hot or cold the environment becomes.
copy.tl: Ang mga endothermic, o warm-blooded, na vertebrate ay nananatiling pareho ang temperatura ng katawan kahit uminit o lumamig ang paligid.
copy.bis: Ang mga endothermic, o warm-blooded, nga vertebrate magpabilin nga pareho ang temperatura sa lawas bisan pa moinit o mobugnaw ang palibot.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Water is used for washing clothes and dishes because it can carry away dirt and soap.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: investigate and describe the relationship among the projectile variables including the angle and velocity of release, and projectile height and range, using everyday activities such as shooting basketballs or kicking footballs
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes a use of water for washing, which is an earth materials topic. G10-F-1 requires investigating projectile motion variables (angle, velocity, height, range). There is no connection to projectile motion.

copy.en: Water is used for washing clothes and dishes because it can carry away dirt and soap.
copy.tl: Ang tubig ay ginagamit sa paghuhugas ng damit at pinggan dahil kaya nitong dalhin palayo ang dumi at sabon.
copy.bis: Ang tubig gigamit sa pagpanghugas og mga sinina ug plato kay makadala kini palayo sa hugaw ug sabon.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Scientists study wasp venom
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: observe and describe the outer body parts of animals, such as head, legs or wings, and identify their role to move and to gather food
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses wasp venom as a potential medicine, not the outer body parts of animals or their role in movement and food gathering. No instructional support for G3-L-4.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Scientists study wasp venom
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: use information from secondary sources to describe examples of how some animals have changed to better suit their environment, such as mimicry or camouflage
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about venom's medicinal potential, not about animals changing to suit their environment (mimicry/camouflage). No instructional support for G5-L-9.

copy.en: Ouch, but useful! Scientists study wasp venom because its chemicals might kill germs or harmful cells — maybe even become new medicine one day.
copy.tl: Masakit, pero may silbi! Pinag-aaralan ng mga siyentipiko ang kamandag ng putakti dahil baka makapatay ito ng mikrobyo o masamang selula — posibleng maging bagong gamot balang araw.
copy.bis: Sakit, apan pulos! Gitun-an sa mga siyentipiko ang hilo sa putyukan kay basin makapatay kini og mikrobyo o daotang selula — posibleng mahimong bag-ong tambal balang adlaw.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The large intestine is the last segment of the gastrointestinal tract that completes absorption and compacts waste into feces.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the Particle Model of Matter as 'All matter is made up of tiny particles with each pure substance having its own kind of particles.'
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes the function of the large intestine in the digestive system. G7-M-2 is about the Particle Model of Matter, which is entirely unrelated to digestion or waste compaction.

copy.en: The large intestine is the last segment of the gastrointestinal tract that completes absorption and compacts waste into feces.
copy.tl: Ang large intestine ang huling bahagi ng gastrointestinal tract na kumukumpleto ng absorption at nagsisiksik ng dumi para maging feces.
copy.bis: Ang large intestine mao ang kataposang segment sa gastrointestinal tract nga mokompleto sa absorption ug mopilit sa hugaw aron mahimong feces.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A glass of water can split sunlight into rainbow colors because the water bends the light, which is called refraction.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the general structure of the solar system, identifying the names of the major celestial objects, their main features, and general composition
assignedReviews.reason: The card explains light refraction and dispersion of sunlight into colors, which is a physics/optics concept. G5-E-11 requires describing the general structure of the solar system, major celestial objects, their features, and composition. The card provides no information about the solar system, planets, or celestial objects, so it does not support this competency.

copy.en: A glass of water can split sunlight into rainbow colors because the water bends the light, which is called refraction.
copy.tl: Ang isang basong may tubig ay kayang hatiin ang sikat ng araw sa mga kulay ng bahaghari dahil nililiko ng tubig ang liwanag, na tinatawag na refraction.
copy.bis: Ang usa ka baso nga may tubig makabahin sa kahayag sa adlaw ngadto sa mga kolor sa balangaw tungod kay gipaliko sa tubig ang kahayag, nga gitawag nga refraction.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Leaves that fall on rivers are carried by flowing water, moving them downstream.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: demonstrate various techniques in separating mixtures, such as decantation, winnowing, scooping, picking, evaporation, filtering, sieving, and using magnets
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes water transporting leaves downstream, which is about movement by flowing water, not any mixture separation technique (decantation, winnowing, scooping, picking, evaporation, filtering, sieving, magnets). No instructional support for G6-M-6.

copy.en: Leaves that fall on rivers are carried by flowing water, moving them downstream.
copy.tl: Ang mga dahong nahuhulog sa ilog ay dinadala ng umaagos na tubig, na nagpapagalaw sa mga ito pababa ng ilog.
copy.bis: Ang mga dahon nga mangahulog sa suba gidala sa nag-agay nga tubig, nga nagpalihok kanila paubos sa suba.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Water molecules have a positive side and a negative side. Each side attracts one of salt's ions and pulls them away from the crystal!
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe changes of state for solids, liquids, and gases as melting, evaporation, freezing, condensation using diagrams and flowcharts
assignedReviews.reason: The card explains the dissolution of salt in water due to water's polarity. It does not describe changes of state (melting, evaporation, freezing, condensation) nor use diagrams/flowcharts as required by G6-M-1.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Water molecules have a positive side and a negative side. Each side attracts one of salt's ions and pulls them away from the crystal!
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain the role of the water cycle in the environment
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about dissolving salt, not about the water cycle or its role in the environment. It provides no support for explaining the water cycle.

copy.en:
Why does water pull salt apart?

Water molecules have a positive side and a negative side. Each side attracts one of salt's ions and pulls them away from the crystal!
copy.tl:
Bakit hinihila ng tubig ang asin para magkahiwalay?

Ang mga molecule ng tubig ay may positive side at negative side. Inaakit ng bawat side ang isa sa mga ions ng asin at hinihila sila palayo sa crystal!
copy.bis:
Ngano nga gibira sa tubig ang asin aron magbulag?

Ang mga molecule sa tubig adunay positive side ug negative side. Ang matag side moatrak sa usa sa mga ions sa asin ug mobira kanila palayo sa crystal!

assignedReviews.card_evidence: It provides a continuous water supply for human consumption and improves health and hygiene practices.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: demonstrate proper handling and disposal of materials according to their properties, such as reusing objects, disposing of excess oil into garbage, and recycling paper, plastic or glass
assignedReviews.reason: The card explains the importance of the water cycle for human water supply and health/hygiene. G3-M-7 requires demonstrating proper handling and disposal of materials (reusing, recycling, disposing of waste). The card does not address material handling or disposal at all, so it is unrelated to the competency.

copy.en: Why is the water cycle important for people?\n\nIt provides a continuous water supply for human consumption and improves health and hygiene practices.
copy.tl:
Bakit mahalaga ang water cycle para sa mga tao?

Nagbibigay ito ng patuloy na suplay ng tubig para sa pangangailangan ng tao at nagpapabuti ng kalusugan at hygiene practices.
copy.bis:
Ngano importante man ang water cycle para sa mga tao?

Naghatag kini ug padayon nga suplay sa tubig para sa panginahanglan sa tao ug nagpauswag sa panglawas ug hygiene practices.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A 65.00 gram sample of water contains 2.17 x 10^24 water molecules
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify that when forces are not balanced, they can cause changes in the object's speed or direction of motion
assignedReviews.reason: The card teaches gram-to-mole conversion using Avogadro's number, a chemistry/stoichiometry concept. It provides no information about unbalanced forces causing changes in speed or direction of motion.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A 65.00 gram sample of water contains 2.17 x 10^24 water molecules
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: participate in guided activities to demonstrate that pushes and pulls can be used to change the speed and direction of an object including making it go faster, turn it to a different direction, slow it down, and stop it
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about counting water molecules, not about pushes and pulls changing the speed or direction of an object. It does not support the G4-F-5 competency in any way.

copy.en: A 65.00 gram sample of water contains 2.17 x 10^24 water molecules, found by converting grams to moles and then multiplying by Avogadro's number.
copy.tl: Ang isang 65.00 gram na sample ng tubig ay naglalaman ng 2.17 x 10^24 water molecules, na nakuha sa pamamagitan ng pag-convert ng grams sa moles at pagkatapos ay pag-multiply sa Avogadro's number.
copy.bis: Ang usa ka 65.00 gram nga sample sa tubig adunay 2.17 x 10^24 water molecules, nga nakuha pinaagi sa pag-convert sa grams ngadto sa moles ug dayon pag-multiply sa Avogadro's number.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Water waves are transverse waves
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe useful everyday examples of uniform and non-uniform mixtures, such as solutions and suspensions
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes water waves as transverse waves, which is a physics/waves topic. G6-M-4 is about uniform and non-uniform mixtures such as solutions and suspensions; the card provides no information about mixtures.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Water waves are transverse waves
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify the role of the solute and solvent in a solution
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about wave motion, not about solutions. G7-M-8 requires identifying the role of solute and solvent in a solution, which the card does not address at all.

copy.en: Water waves are transverse waves, because the water surface moves up and down while the wave travels across the water.
copy.tl: Ang water waves ay transverse waves, dahil ang surface ng tubig ay gumagalaw pataas-baba habang ang wave ay naglalakbay sa tubig.
copy.bis: Ang water waves mga transverse waves, tungod kay ang surface sa tubig molihok pataas-paubos samtang ang wave mobiyahe sa tubig.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Keep important documents in waterproof bags so they will not get wet when your place becomes flooded.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify advantageous and disadvantageous examples of conduction, convection, and radiation
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about flood safety and protecting documents, with no mention of conduction, convection, or radiation. It does not support identifying advantageous or disadvantageous examples of heat transfer.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Keep important documents in waterproof bags so they will not get wet when your place becomes flooded.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain in terms of the particle model the processes underlying convection and conduction of heat energy
assignedReviews.reason: The card has no content about the particle model, convection, or conduction of heat energy. It is unrelated to this competency.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Keep important documents in waterproof bags so they will not get wet when your place becomes flooded.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: observe and identify sources and uses of light, sound, and heat energy at school, at home and in the local community
assignedReviews.reason: The card does not address sources or uses of light, sound, or heat energy. It is about flood preparedness, not energy sources.

copy.en: Keep important documents in waterproof bags so they will not get wet when your place becomes flooded.
copy.tl: Ilagay ang mahahalagang dokumento sa waterproof bag para hindi mabasa kapag bumaha sa inyong lugar.
copy.bis: Ibutang ang importanteng mga dokumento sa waterproof bag aron dili mabasa kung mobaha sa inyong lugar.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The wavelength, or distance between wave crests, depends on the frequency
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe useful everyday examples of uniform and non-uniform mixtures, such as solutions and suspensions
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses wave properties (wavelength and frequency), which is physics content. G6-M-4 is about mixtures (solutions and suspensions), a matter topic. No instructional support for mixtures.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The wavelength, or distance between wave crests, depends on the frequency
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify the role of the solute and solvent in a solution
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses wave properties, not the role of solute and solvent in a solution. G7-M-8 is about solutions, a matter topic. No instructional support for solute/solvent roles.

copy.en: The wavelength, or distance between wave crests, depends on the frequency of the disturbance, which is how often the wave is made.
copy.tl: Ang wavelength, o distansya sa pagitan ng mga crest ng wave, ay nakadepende sa frequency ng disturbance, kung gaano kadalas ginagawa ang wave.
copy.bis: Ang wavelength, o distansya tali sa mga crest sa wave, nagdepende sa frequency sa disturbance, kon unsa ka subsob gihimo ang wave.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Electromagnetic waves are moving energy that travels through space
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: investigate the effects of static electricity using common materials, such as a comb, plastic and glass rods, and balloons
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes electromagnetic waves and their properties (wavelength, frequency, energy). G5-F-7 requires investigating static electricity using common materials like a comb, plastic/glass rods, and balloons. The card content is unrelated to static electricity and does not support the competency.

copy.en: Electromagnetic waves are moving energy that travels through space, and each wave has a wavelength, a frequency, and an amount of energy.
copy.tl: Ang electromagnetic waves ay gumagalaw na enerhiya na naglalakbay sa kalawakan, at bawat wave ay may wavelength, frequency, at dami ng enerhiya.
copy.bis: Ang electromagnetic waves mao ang naglihok nga enerhiya nga mobiyahe sa kawanangan, ug ang matag wave adunay wavelength, frequency, ug gidaghanon sa enerhiya.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The speed of bubbling or the time it takes for a solid to dissolve are two simple ways to observe and compare how fast chemical reactions happen.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: observe and record changes in the weather during a day or over some days and describe the different types and patterns of weather in the local area
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about observing the speed of chemical reactions (bubbling, dissolving), which is a chemistry topic. G3-E-4 requires observing and recording weather changes and describing weather types/patterns. There is no weather content or any connection to the competency.

copy.en: The speed of bubbling or the time it takes for a solid to dissolve are two simple ways to observe and compare how fast chemical reactions happen.
copy.tl: Ang bilis ng pagbula o ang oras na kailangan para matunaw ang isang solid ay dalawang simpleng paraan upang maobserbahan at maikumpara kung gaano kabilis mangyari ang mga chemical reaction.
copy.bis: Ang kapaspas sa pagbula o ang oras nga gikinahanglan aron matunaw ang usa ka solid maoy duha ka simple nga paagi sa pag-obserbar ug pagtandi kung unsa kapaspas mahitabo ang mga chemical reaction.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Always wear protective gear like a laboratory coat, gloves, and goggles
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: observe the outer parts of plants, such as leaves, roots, and stems and identify their role to get water and nutrients from the soil
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about laboratory safety and protective gear, not about observing the outer parts of plants or their roles in water/nutrient uptake.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Always wear protective gear like a laboratory coat, gloves, and goggles
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe how plant organs (leaf, stem, roots) work together as the transport system
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about laboratory safety and protective gear, not about how plant organs work together as a transport system.

copy.en: Always wear protective gear like a laboratory coat, gloves, and goggles during experiments to keep chemicals away from your skin and eyes.
copy.tl: Laging magsuot ng protective gear tulad ng laboratory coat, gloves, at goggles habang nag-e-eksperimento upang maprotektahan ang iyong balat at mata mula sa mga kemikal.
copy.bis: Kanunay nga magsul-ob og protective gear sama sa laboratory coat, gloves, ug goggles samtang nag-eksperimento aron mapanalipdan ang imong panit ug mata sa mga kemikal.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: weather can change from morning to midday to afternoon
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain how the subduction of an oceanic plate impacts on the plate above it
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about daily weather changes, not about subduction of oceanic plates or any plate tectonics content.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: weather can change from morning to midday to afternoon
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the structures, movements and events that occur at each type of plate boundary
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes weather variation during a day, not structures, movements, or events at plate boundaries.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: weather can change from morning to midday to afternoon
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: relate the location and distribution of active volcanoes, earthquake epicenters, and major mountain belts to the distribution of oceanic crust and continental crust
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about weather, not the distribution of volcanoes, earthquake epicenters, or mountain belts relative to crust types.

copy.en:
Does the weather stay the same all day?

No, weather can change from morning to midday to afternoon—it may be sunny in the morning and rainy later.
copy.tl:
Pareho ba ang panahon sa buong araw?

Hindi, maaaring magbago ang panahon mula umaga hanggang tanghali hanggang hapon—maaaring maaraw sa umaga at maulan mamaya.
copy.bis:
Pareho ba ang panahon sa tibuok adlaw?

Dili, mahimong mausab ang panahon gikan sa buntag hangtod sa udto hangtod sa hapon—mahimong init sa buntag ug mag-uwan unya.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: During dangerous weather, listen to the radio or television for news about the weather
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify examples of how objects can affect other objects even when they are not in contact with each other, such as magnets attracting other objects, light from the sun, and loud noises hurting our ears
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about safety during dangerous weather by listening to weather news. It does not address objects affecting other objects without contact (non-contact forces) such as magnets, light, or sound. The content is unrelated to the competency.

copy.en: During dangerous weather, listen to the radio or television for news about the weather so you know what to do and where to go.
copy.tl: Kapag may mapanganib na panahon, makinig sa radyo o telebisyon para sa balita tungkol sa panahon para malaman mo kung ano ang gagawin at kung saan pupunta.
copy.bis: Kung adunay delikado nga panahon, paminaw sa radyo o telebisyon alang sa balita mahitungod sa panahon aron mahibalo ka kung unsa ang buhaton ug asa moadto.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: At least 150 minutes of moderate exercise
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the general structure of the solar system, identifying the names of the major celestial objects, their main features, and general composition
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses recommended weekly exercise duration for health, which is unrelated to the solar system, celestial objects, or their composition. The competency G5-E-11 requires describing the general structure of the solar system, which this card does not support in any way.

copy.en:
How much exercise do you need each week to stay healthy?

At least 150 minutes of moderate exercise each week helps strengthen your heart and lungs and prevents diseases.
copy.tl:
Gaano karaming ehersisyo ang kailangan mo bawat linggo para manatiling malusog?

Hindi bababa sa 150 minuto ng katamtamang ehersisyo bawat linggo ay nakakatulong para lumakas ang iyong puso at baga at maiwasan ang mga sakit.
copy.bis:
Pila ka minuto nga ehersisyo ang kinahanglan nimo kada semana aron magpabiling himsog?

Dili moubos sa 150 ka minuto nga kasarangan nga ehersisyo kada semana makatabang sa pagpalig-on sa imong kasingkasing ug baga ug paglikay sa mga sakit.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Potential energy can also be found by multiplying the object's weight, which is a force measured in newtons, by its height
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: use information from secondary sources to describe that living things interact with each other in the natural environment, such as through competition, or predation
assignedReviews.reason: The card is not living things interacting through competition or predation.

copy.en: Potential energy can also be found by multiplying the object's weight, which is a force measured in newtons, by its height.
copy.tl: Ang potential energy ay maaari ring makuha sa pamamagitan ng pag-multiply ng weight ng bagay, na isang puwersa na sinusukat sa newtons, sa taas nito.
copy.bis: Ang potential energy mahimo usab nga makuha pinaagi sa pag-multiply sa weight sa butang, nga usa ka puwersa nga gisukod sa newtons, sa kataason.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Alleles are different versions of the same gene
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: use information from secondary sources to identify the products of traditional biotechnology through fermentation (e.g. cheese, soy sauce, vinegar, nata de coco)
assignedReviews.reason: The card explains alleles as gene versions and inheritance from parents. It has no connection to traditional biotechnology products from fermentation (cheese, soy sauce, vinegar, nata de coco).

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Alleles are different versions of the same gene
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: recognize that some organisms consist of a single cell (unicellular) like in bacteria and some consist of many cells (multicellular) like in a human
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about alleles and inheritance, not about unicellular vs multicellular organisms. It does not support recognizing single-celled vs many-celled organisms.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Alleles are variant forms of a gene
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: demonstrate various techniques in separating mixtures, such as decantation, winnowing, scooping, picking, evaporation, filtering, sieving, and using magnets
assignedReviews.reason: The card explains alleles and genetics, which has no connection to mixture separation techniques (decantation, filtering, etc.).

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Alleles are variant forms of a gene
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: carry out guided investigations to identify the properties of magnets, including how they affect other magnets and objects made of different materials
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about alleles and inheritance, not about magnets or magnetic properties.

copy.en: Alleles are different versions of the same gene, like two flavors of the same ice cream recipe, and you inherit one allele from each parent.
copy.tl: Ang alleles ay magkaibang bersyon ng iisang gene, parang dalawang flavor ng iisang ice cream recipe, at namamana mo ang isang allele mula sa bawat magulang.
copy.bis: Ang alleles kay lain-laing bersyon sa usa ka gene, sama sa duha ka flavor sa usa ka ice cream recipe, ug makapanunod ka ug usa ka allele sa matag ginikanan.
